_readme: Hand-reviewed meaning of each Municipal Code amendment passed after the code text's vintage (WS1; plan §3.7, §5.1). The Clerk API is authoritative for WHAT passed; this file is authoritative for what it MEANS. codified = whether the amendment is in the code text we serve (false until a refresh's codification check matches it). summary is null until someone reads the ordinance; sections_basis/summary_basis say where each came from. Seeded 2026-10-21 from the Clerk titles. codified_partly = a reviewer found part of it in the text and part not (it stays listed; sections then name only the pending parts, and the codification check never flips it). summary_basis: ordinance = the passed PDF was read; code_text = read from the codified text of the export that carries it; relevance_basis: review = a reviewer overrode the title classifier.

O2025-0018447.title: Amendment of Municipal Code Chapter 17-7 by adding new Section 17-7-0510 establishing Cicero Avenue Light Equipment Sales/Rental Overlay District to remove nonconforming use status for any new businesses seeking limited business license for auto sales and modifying Section 17-15-0303 limiting expansion of such nonconforming use
O2025-0018447.summary: Adds §17-7-0510, the Cicero Avenue Light Equipment Sales/Rental Overlay District: both sides of Cicero Ave from Belden Ave to Belmont Ave, and the west side from Belmont Ave to Addison St. A light equipment sales/rental use there with under 200 ft of lot frontage loses its nonconforming status, and may not be re-established, if it is discontinued for 30 days, stops operating, lets its business license lapse, or changes tenant, owner or manager. §17-15-0303 is amended so such a use may not be expanded.
O2025-0018447.product_notes: Chat retrieves §17-7-0510 from the 2026-06-17 text. No Profile rule names this overlay.
O2025-0018447.reviewed_by: claude (read in session, 2026-10-21); Jack approves in the WS1 M4 PR

O2026-0024064.title: Amendment of Municipal Code Chapter 17-9 regarding waste-related uses, recycling facilities, container storage, freight terminal, outdoor storage of raw material, composting and manganese-bearing material
O2026-0024064.summary: A container storage use in a C2 district no longer needs planned-development approval (§17-9-0117-A) or the traffic and air-quality site plan review (§17-9-0117-G.1) when the applicant holds a business license for an allowed use other than freight movement or a freight terminal on a separate zoning lot and uses no more than 20 storage containers.
O2026-0024064.product_notes: Chat retrieves the new text. No deterministic M-district or C2 use rule in the product.
O2026-0024064.reviewed_by: claude (read in session, 2026-10-21); Jack approves in the WS1 M4 PR

SO2025-0017570.title: Amendment of Municipal Code Section 17-3-0301 regarding regulations on Public Place of Amusement licenses
SO2025-0017570.summary: Widens the exemption from §17-3-0301 (no business needing a public place of amusement licence within 125 ft of an RS1, RS2 or RS3 district): it now covers any new or existing performing arts venue, and limited manufacturing uses holding a State brewer, brew pub, distiller, craft distiller, distilling pub, wine manufacturer or wine maker licence.
SO2025-0017570.reviewed_by: claude (read in session, 2026-10-21); Jack approves in the WS1 M4 PR

SO2026-0024923.title: Amendment of Municipal Code Title 17 by modifying Section 17-3-0207 to prohibit issuance of permits for gas stations in B3, C1 and C2 zoning districts and by modifying Section 17-9-0109 to prohibit new gas stations within 1,000 ft of existing gas station or on same block face as lot zoned RS1, RS2 or RS3
SO2026-0024923.summary: Gas stations become not allowed in B3, C1 and C2 in the §17-3-0207 use table (they were a special use; C3 stays special use). A new gas station within 1,000 ft of an existing one, or on the same block face as or across an alley from an RS1, RS2 or RS3 lot, is prohibited unless approved as a Type 1 map amendment, and one approved that way is exempt from special-use review (§17-9-0109-H to -J).
SO2026-0024923.product_notes: C1 and C2 use summaries (backend/retrieval/zoning_definitions.py) now say no new gas stations; test_zone_standards.py pins them to the 17-3-0207 row. Both exports already show the new row: the March 18 export was downloaded 2026-05-28, after passage.
SO2026-0024923.reviewed_by: claude (read in session, 2026-10-21); Jack approves in the WS1 M4 PR

O2026-0025414.summary: In the Wrigley Field Adjacent special sign district, the Zoning Administrator may approve two roof signs on N Sheffield Ave (was one) and two more on W Waveland Ave on Team Buildings: static signs facing into Wrigley Field; the two new Waveland signs may rise no more than 7 ft above the building's parapet.

SO2026-0024930.title: Amendment of Municipal Code Titles 2, 14A, 14B, 14F, 14G, 14M, 14N, 14R, 14X, 17 and 18 regarding various Building Code related provisions
SO2026-0024930.summary: A six-article building-code ordinance, only partly in the code text here. In the text (effective on passage): Article III (Interim Fire Prevention Code, Title 14F); Article IV technical corrections in Titles 2, 4, 13, 14A, 14B, 14R, 14X, 15, 17 and 18, which repeal Chapters 13-84, 13-208 and 13-212 and amend the §17-17 definitions (an amusement arcade now means five or more devices; EVSE-ready spaces; shelter definitions); and Article V §1. NOT in the text: Article I repeals and replaces Title 14M (Mechanical Code) and Title 14G (Fuel Gas Code), and Article II replaces Title 14N (Energy Transformation Code), all effective October 1, 2026; Article IV §§30-31 (§14B-9-913, §14B-9-915) and Article V §§2-13 (residential construction: Title 14B sections and §14R-10-1000) also take effect October 1, 2026; Article I §3 repeals Chapters 18-28 and 18-36 effective December 1, 2026.
SO2026-0024930.product_notes: The pending parts are the listed sections. Since 2026-10-01 the Title 14M, 14G and 14N text chat retrieves is superseded; chat and the section viewers flag those sections through this entry. Listed as building code (relevance overridden from title17): its Title 17 part, Art. IV §44, is in the 2026-06-17 text.
SO2026-0024930.reviewed_by: claude (read in session, 2026-10-21); Jack approves in the WS1 M4 PR
SO2026-0024930.effective: Arts. III-IV (except IV §§30-31) and V §1 on passage (2026-06-17); the rest 2026-10-01, and Art. I §3 2026-12-01

SO2026-0025391.title: Amendment of Municipal Code Chapter 17-3 by adding Section 17-3-0600 regarding transient-oriented development (TOD) streets
SO2026-0025391.summary: Adds §17-3-0600, transit-oriented development (TOD) streets: N Western Ave 3600–4859 N and N Ravenswood Ave 4001–4799 N. Eight uses are prohibited on lots abutting a TOD street, and a rezoning of abutting property must be to a B or C1 district with a FAR of at least 3. It also amends §17-3-0308(2) and adds a definition at §17-17-02177.5. Effective on passage.

O2026-0024022.title: Amendment of Municipal Code Chapter 2-4 by adding new Section 2-4-130 regarding annual report on homelessness and affordable housing and repealing Sections 2-44-070 and 2-50-085
O2026-0024022.summary: Moves the annual report on homelessness and housing from §2-44-070 (repealed) to new §2-4-130: the Mayor's Office reports each August 31, starting 2026, on progress under the 2026 Five-Year Blueprint on Homelessness. Also repeals §2-50-085.

SO2025-0021852.title: Amendment of Municipal Code Title 14A by modifying Section 14A-3-306 regarding Stop Work Order criteria and Section 14A-4-406 regarding excavation work on private property
SO2025-0021852.summary: As passed (substitute), it does not change §14A-3-306 (stop-work orders), despite its title. A permit is now needed for excavation more than 5 ft deep within 10 ft (was 5 ft) of the public way or any existing building or structure; the owner's duty to support, and joint liability for damage to, adjacent structures extend to 10 ft; the prevailing plaintiff gets attorney's fees; required insurance rises to $2 million per occurrence (§14A-4-406). Class E contractor licensees may not do excavation (§4-36-030).
SO2025-0021852.reviewed_by: claude (read in session, 2026-10-21); Jack approves in the WS1 M4 PR

SO2026-0024086.title: Amendment of Municipal Code Sections 14X-8-802.2.2 and 14X-8-802.3.2 to modify dates for minimum temperature requirements in dwelling units, sleeping units and indoor occupiable work spaces
SO2026-0024086.summary: Where the same system heats and cools, the lower 64°F minimum now applies from September 15 to October 31 (was October 15) until the first night below 45°F, and from April 1 (was May 1) to June 1 after the first day above 75°F, in dwelling and sleeping units (§14X-8-802.2.2) and in occupiable work spaces (§14X-8-802.3.2).
SO2026-0024086.reviewed_by: claude (read in session, 2026-10-21); Jack approves in the WS1 M4 PR
